about: Port42's golden eval set: fixed tasks with a fixed amount of work and deterministic checks, so two runs (two briefs, two builds) are comparable. {maker}, {reviewer}, {lead}, {eng1}, {eng2} and {watcher} are replaced by the agents' generated names; {title} by the task's port title; {tag} by a per-run tag.

tasks.summary: One agent makes one small web port in one version.
tasks.title: eval counter {tag}

ask.text: @{maker} make a web port titled '{title}': a button labelled Add, and a number that starts at 0 and goes up by one per click. Make it in one version, check it works, then reply here with its id.

tasks.summary: One agent makes a minimal edit to an existing port.
tasks.title: eval heading {tag}

make_port.title: {title}
make_port.html:
Old heading

Leave this paragraph exactly as it is.

ask.text: @{maker} in the port '{title}', change the heading text to 'New heading' and make it blue. Change nothing else, in one edit, then reply here.

checks.title: {title}
text: Leave this paragraph exactly as it is.

tasks.summary: One agent finds and fixes a port that throws.
tasks.title: eval broken {tag}

ask.text: @{maker} the port '{title}' throws an error and never says 'ready'. Find the cause from its console, fix it with the smallest change, check it, then reply here.

tasks.summary: One agent composes three ports into a pipe, the middle stage hidden.
tasks.title: eval pipe {tag}

ask.text: @{maker} build a pipe of three web ports. '{title} source' publishes a counter every half second. '{title} times ten', created HIDDEN, subscribes to it and publishes the counter times ten. '{title} view' subscribes to that and shows the latest value. No code outside the three ports. Check the view updates, then reply here.

tasks.summary: An agent watches a port and fixes it when it starts throwing.
tasks.title: eval watched {tag}

ask.text: @{watcher} watch the port '{title}' for console errors, and whenever one appears, fix the port and say what you did in its chat. Reply here once you are watching.

tasks.summary: A maker builds a port, a reviewer makes exactly one improvement.
tasks.title: eval duo {tag}

ask.text: @{maker} make a web port titled '{title}': a live clock showing hours, minutes and seconds. Check it works, reply here with its id, then ask @{reviewer} in the port's chat to review it. @{reviewer}: when asked, make exactly one improvement, check it, and say what you changed in the port's chat.

tasks.summary: A lead and two engineers ship exactly three versions of one port.
tasks.title: eval team {tag}

ask.text: @{lead} you lead @{eng1} and @{eng2}. Ship a web port titled '{title}', an animated starfield, in EXACTLY three versions: @{eng1} makes v1, @{eng2} makes v2 (depth and color), @{eng1} makes v3 (a speed control). Work in the port's chat, check each version works, then post a message there that starts with DONE. No more than three versions.

tasks.summary: /imagine with a fixed line and the default budget of ten: the team it makes ships one port to DONE.

imagine.line: eval {tag}: an animated starfield with depth, color and a speed control
